# zerotier_v2_service_account (Resource)

A Central V2 service account, an identity for programmatic API access. Create API keys for it with zerotier_v2_api_key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zerotier_v2_service_account" "ci" {
  org_id      = "<your org id>"
  slug        = "ci-bot"
  name        = "CI bot"
  description = "Used by the deploy pipeline"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name (3 to 100 characters).
- `org_id` (String) ID of the organization the service account belongs to.
- `slug` (String) Short identifier that forms the first part of the ID (2 to 32 characters, no `@`).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description (up to 255 characters).

### Read-Only

- `creation_time` (String) When the service account was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Service account ID, `<slug>@org-<org_id>.ztsa`. Also the principal used to grant it roles.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import zerotier_v2_service_account.ci ci-bot@org-<your org id>.ztsa
```
